description: Use when the user wants to let an AI employee team go (teamId from list_teams). The first call, without confirm, only says what will happen and changes nothing: threads stay readable, approvals still waiting expire, the subscription is cancelled at the end of the paid period and the members work until then (immediate: true lets them go now), and nothing is refunded. Call again with confirm: true only after the user explicitly agrees — never confirm on the user's behalf. mode "disband_keep_members" is not available yet. Only the person who launched the team or a workspace admin can. No cost to call.

confirm.description: true only after the user's explicit yes.

immediate.description: Let the members go now rather than at the end of the paid period.

name: fire_team

outputSchema.description: Without confirm: what will happen. With it: the team let go and when its members stop.

title: Fire Team
